edit.description: discovers_path (723-760) finds info/exclude where the ignore walk does, following a `.git` file to the common git dir
a linked-worktree case agreeing with the walk

summary: The guard's single-path discovery query reads `.git/info/exclude` as a directory path only, so in a linked worktree it disagrees with the ignore walk check runs
acceptance: In a harness whose `.git` is a worktree pointer file, a path the common git dir's info/exclude names is undiscoverable to discovers_path, as it is to ignore_walk
tests: the single path query agrees with the discovery walk in a linked worktree
notes: import.rs:750 joins dir/.git/info/exclude. The ignore crate resolves a `.git` file (gitdir:, then commondir) before reading exclude. Earlier this was accepted as debt (ignore-precedence-mirror) with the agreement test as tripwire, but that test builds a real .git dir and cannot see this case. Prefer deriving from the ignore crate's own resolution over a second hand-roll, where the crate exposes one.
